When you or a loved one is ready to break the cycle of addiction, finding the right environment is everything. While Marin County consistently ranks among the healthiest regions in California, local public health data reveals a hidden crisis: overdose is a leading cause of death for residents aged 55 and under, with the local fatal drug overdose rate having previously climbed to 25.5 per 100,000 residents. The intense pressure of a high-achieving lifestyle in areas like San Rafael, Mill Valley, and Tiburon often masks these deep-seated struggles with substance use and mental health, making a professional clinical intervention essential to safely begin recovery.

The ideal space for healing isn’t thousands of miles away, it is right across the Golden Gate Bridge. Located directly on Marina Boulevard with peaceful waterfront views, Marina Harbor Detox provides an easily accessible, ultra-private sanctuary where we deliver a comprehensive continuum of integrated medical detox, inpatient residential treatment, and specialized dual diagnosis care that addresses addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions simultaneously. Crossing the bridge establishes a crucial psychological boundary, giving you the necessary distance to escape local triggers and focus 100% on your 24/7 medically supervised stabilization while remaining close enough for seamless family support.

Our Clinical Approach & Evidence-Based Therapies in Marin County

True healing requires a deliberate blend of advanced medical stabilization and deeply personalized clinical therapy. At Marina Harbor Detox, our therapeutic approach addresses the underlying psychological drivers of substance use rather than just physical withdrawal. We design highly individualized treatment plans that integrate evidence-based modalities like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT). These therapies allow clients to identify self-destructive behavioral patterns, develop healthy emotional regulation, and build practical coping mechanisms tailored to navigating the unique lifestyle pressures and high-stress environments common in Marin County.

Because trauma, chronic anxiety, and executive burnout frequently coexist with dependency, our clinical team seamlessly weaves specialized dual diagnosis care into daily programming. We combine traditional talk therapy with holistic and restorative practices, ensuring that the mind and body recover in tandem. In our intimate waterfront environment on Marina Boulevard, our elite staffing ratio allows for intensive individual therapy sessions and focused, small-group clinical work that respects your dignity and privacy. This comprehensive approach ensures that you leave our facility physically stabilized and equipped with the resilient psychological toolkit required for lasting, long-term sobriety.

Addiction Recovery Support Resources in Marin County

Building a sustainable life in recovery requires ongoing peer support and localized community connection once clinical stabilization is complete. Whether you are transitioning back home from our residential program or navigating early recovery, Marin County offers a deeply supportive, active fellowship network. These peer-led groups provide the essential accountability and community framework needed to maintain long-term sobriety.
Alcoholics Anonymous (AA) in Marin County: Managed locally by the San Francisco and Marin Intergroup, a robust network of daily meetings runs throughout the North Bay.

Narcotics Anonymous (NA) in Marin County: The Marin County Fellowship of NA hosts vital daily recovery meetings across the county for those recovering from drug and prescription medication dependencies.

Family Support Groups: Because recovery impacts the entire family unit, Marin County features numerous Al-Anon and Nar-Anon meetings designed to support the parents, spouses, and loved ones of individuals navigating substance use disorders.
Getting to Our Waterfront Facility from Marin County

Located at 289 Marina Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94123, our waterfront facility is a straightforward 20-to-30-minute drive from anywhere in the North Bay. Crossing the Golden Gate Bridge provides a clean, therapeutic transition away from daily stressors into a dedicated space for healing. Direct Routes from Marin County Hubs:
From San Rafael & Central Marin: Take Highway 101 South straight through Corte Madera and Larkspur, proceeding directly across the Golden Gate Bridge.
From Mill Valley & Southern Marin: Connect to Highway 101 South via East Blithedale Avenue or Shoreline Highway toward the bridge approach.
From Tiburon: Take Tiburon Boulevard (SR 131) West to merge onto Highway 101 South.

For those crossing the bridge into San Francisco, take the Downtown/Lombard Street (US-101 South) exit. Follow Richardson Avenue onto Lombard Street, turn left on Divisadero Street, and then turn right onto Marina Boulevard. Our private facility sits on the right, directly facing the waterfront.
